question: A 70 kg patient requires lignocaine infiltration. Which of the following represents the correct maximum safe dose WITH added adrenaline (1:200,000)?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: 3 mg/kg is the maximum for plain lignocaine (without adrenaline). Adding adrenaline allows a higher ceiling.
Close — 5 mg/kg is sometimes cited as the plain lignocaine ceiling in some texts, but with adrenaline the NMC/standard limit is 7 mg/kg.
Correct. Lignocaine with adrenaline: maximum 7 mg/kg (up to 500 mg). The vasoconstrictor slows systemic absorption, raising the safe ceiling from 3 mg/kg (plain).
10 mg/kg exceeds the safe limit even with adrenaline and risks systemic toxicity. The ceiling is 7 mg/kg with adrenaline.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review LA maximum doses: lignocaine plain 3 mg/kg, with adrenaline 7 mg/kg. These are high-yield examination facts.
Excellent. Remember the key numbers: Lignocaine plain = 3 mg/kg; with adrenaline = 7 mg/kg. Bupivacaine plain = 2 mg/kg; with adrenaline = 2.5 mg/kg.
